children: UK online gambling tech provider's H1 revenue rose 10% yr/yr to €425.1 mln
Adjusted EBITDA rose sharply, driven by growth in the Americas and operational leverage
Company completed €25 mln share buyback during H1
Playtech expects FY 2026 Adjusted EBITDA of more than €270 mln
Company says H2 Adjusted EBITDA will be lower than H1 due to normalising HRD revenue and higher UK gaming duty
Playtech expects to achieve medium-term targets of €250-300 mln Adjusted EBITDA and €70-100 mln Free Cash Flow earlier than anticipated
AMERICAS GROWTH - Co said strong revenue growth in the Americas, especially the US and Canada, drove results
HARD ROCK DIGITAL PARTNERSHIP - Partnership with Hard Rock Digital, especially Games powered by Past Motor Racing in Florida, was a key growth driver
LATIN AMERICA EXPANSION - Strong performance in Mexico and Colombia, supported by partnerships and regulatory changes, contributed to growth
